settings.transformationHubDescription: The Workshop is being organised by Allstates Management Partners Solutions Limited under the auspices of the Office of the Vice President of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, in collaboration with key strategic institutional partners, namely the Federal Ministry of Power, Federal Ministry of Justice, Nigerian Electricity Regulatory Commission (NERC), and the Nigeria Governors' Forum (NGF). This collaboration underscores a shared commitment to supporting the effective implementation of the Electricity Act 2023, strengthening institutional capacity, encouraging public-private collaboration and accelerating the development of competitive, sustainable and investment-ready State electricity markets.

settings.aboutHeroSubtitle: The Electricity Act 2023 marks a historic milestone in Nigeria's power sector by empowering State Governments to establish, regulate and develop electricity markets within their jurisdictions. The Act creates significant opportunities to expand energy access, attract investment, stimulate industrial development and drive sustainable economic growth. Realising these opportunities, however, requires effective policy implementation, institutional preparedness and strong collaboration among governments, regulators, investors and development partners.
